text:
julia: heads up — build on main failing after i18n merge, pages with emoji in headings + trailing punctuation produce weird slugs and break Docusaurus TOC.

docs-ci: build failed: Error: invalid slug "" generated for heading "Install: Windows 🪟"

kai: seen this before. emoji + trailing colon -> slug generator yields empty segment. also noticed some Windows path examples in fenced code are turning into broken links when copy-pasted (backslashes get swallowed in some renderers).

sam: small fix: add explicit header IDs and normalize sample paths in code blocks. e.g.:

```
## Install {#install-windows}

```bash
# use forward slashes in examples
npm run start -- --config ./config/windows-example.json
```

sam: also add a small remark in contributing docs about using forward slashes in docs snippets to avoid renderer quirks.

maria: I'll open a PR to replace problematic headings and run linkcheck + preview. PR title: "docs: explicit header ids for emoji headings + normalize snippet paths on Windows". Assigning to @kai for review.

kai: thanks. can we also add a sanitizer step in docsite-build that collapses repeated punctuation in headings and strips trailing colons before slugify? saves future surprises.

maria: yes, I'll add a tiny remark and a unit test for slugize behavior.

docs-ci: preview build for PR #2345 passed ✓ — linkcheck shows no broken anchors on preview.

sam: please cherry-pick into release/v1.8.0 and include a brief entry in the changelog: "docs: fix heading slug collision with emoji and normalize docs snippets" :shipit:

julia: perfect, thanks everyone :thumbsup: closing once cherry-pick done.
